text: Grid-search scoring metric is accuracy. The paper does not specify it explicitly.
DNN hidden layer widths are 64-32-16. The paper mentions '3 hidden layers' without specifying sizes.
Naïve Bayes var_smoothing grid is [1e-9, 1e-8, 1e-7]. The paper says 'smoothing parameters' without values.
DNN is tuned on a 20% validation split of the training set, with config selected by last-epoch validation accuracy (no early stopping). The paper says 'validation split' without further detail.
Zero values in Cholesterol (172 rows) and RestingBP (1 row) are kept as-is to match the paper-faithful run.
Random Forest grid: n_estimators ∈ {100,200,300}, max_features ∈ {sqrt, log2}.
Logistic Regression grid: solver ∈ {liblinear, saga}, C ∈ {0.1,1,10}.
DNN grid: batch ∈ {16,32}, lr ∈ {0.001,0.01}, epochs ∈ {20,50}. Architecture: Adam optimizer, binary cross-entropy loss.
